title: Data Scientist Career Accelerator: From Python to Production Insights
description: A project-based course that takes you from programming and statistics fundamentals to building, evaluating, and communicating machine learning models. You'll work with real datasets to build a portfolio of analyses, dashboards, and end-to-end ML projects that prove you're ready for a data scientist role.
audience: Aspiring data scientists, analysts, or developers with basic computer literacy who want to transition into a data science role through hands-on, portfolio-building work.

moduleTitles.5: Generative AI and LLM Foundations for Data Scientists
